task.description: Perform WF-02 Step 2c (security gate, HARD GATE) for REQ-373 per docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md and your own role file .claude/agents/security-reviewer.md. Read `git diff main...HEAD` yourself (do not trust ELIXIR-DEV's self-report) and the artifacts_in list above. For each of INV-1..INV-8 in security-invariants.md, determine APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE and run its 'How to verify' check for every APPLIES invariant. Specifically scrutinize: (1) the two new publish/retire routes are genuinely gated by :AdminServicesManage (re-derive by reading lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex's actual prefix-match logic against the new route paths yourself, not by trusting ELIXIR-DEV's claim it 'automatically covers' them); (2) no tenant-id/user-input string interpolation into raw SQL anywhere in the new migration or new modules; (3) the retire operation's failure mode for NEW resolutions (verify it fails closed, not open -- a security-relevant property, since 'falls through to current version' vs 'fails outright' has different blast-radius implications for an admin retiring a compromised/broken service version) matches what the design specified and what ELIXIR-DEV actually implemented; (4) tenant scoping -- confirm service_catalog/service_catalog_versions reads/writes remain correctly tenant-schema-scoped (prefix-based), no cross-tenant leak introduced by the new archive table or the new Lookup module. FAIL immediately on any applicable invariant failing -- all BLOCKER, no partial credit. Set this handoff's status to COMPLETED with your genuine independent verdict, commit and push before ending your turn.
